description: This file defines the ParquetReadState class, a helper class used for managing intermediate state while reading a Parquet column chunk in Apache Spark's SQL module. It handles row ranges, batch and page resets, and repeated value processing.

classes.name: ParquetReadState
classes.description: A class that maintains the state during reading of a Parquet column chunk, including row ranges, levels, and batch/page management.

methods.name: constructRanges
methods.description: Constructs a list of row ranges from a given iterator of row indexes.

methods.name: resetForNewBatch
methods.description: Resets internal counters and flags at the start of reading a new batch.

methods.name: resetForNewPage
methods.description: Resets state for reading a new page, setting total values and first row index.

methods.name: currentRangeStart
methods.description: Returns the start index of the current row range.

methods.name: currentRangeEnd
methods.description: Returns the end index of the current row range.

methods.name: nextRange
methods.description: Advances to the next row range, or sets sentinel ranges if none are available.
